description: Create an order to collect in person. Returns the order id, total and a claim (keep it); pay it with pay_order. The shop emails the pickup pass to `email` once it's paid, and where the chat shows cards the order shows as one that becomes the pass. Where the shop takes cards, `payment: "card"` returns a checkout link for the user to pay on instead.

dietary_note.description: The user's dietary needs for the shop, in their words (an allergy, an intolerance), where get_shop says it takes dietary notes. Only what the user said; leave it out if they said nothing.

email.description: The user's email. The pickup pass goes here too.

options.description: The ids of this line's chosen options from get_shop (a size, a colour, an add-on). Ask for a required choice that has no default.

name.description: Name for the order, shown to staff

payment.description: Who pays: agent (USDC over x402, or a test payment at a test shop), card (the user pays on a checkout link), or test (where the shop takes test payments: the whole flow with no money moving). Default: agent where the shop takes it, else card.

pickup_at.description: When the user wants to collect, if not as soon as possible: a time in the shop's own time zone (get_shop gives its local time) like "17:30" or "5:30pm" (today, or tomorrow once it has passed), or an ISO time. It must be when the shop is open, within 7 days. Leave it out for as soon as possible.

shop_url.description: An agentPickup shop's URL, as find_shops returns it. Defaults to https://agentpickup.app.

name: create_pickup_order
title: Order for pickup
